svg.title: Hybrid Billing HA and failure handling proposal
svg.desc: Three independent fault domains, redundant ingress and service pools, Kafka brokers and dedicated controller roles, PostgreSQL primary and two standbys with coordination quorum and fencing, two ClickHouse replicas with three Keeper members, HA data and RAG dependencies, independent backup and disaster recovery. This is a proposed placement, not three total servers or verified capacity.
svg.text: Hybrid Billing · HA & Failure Handling

Object Storage / Table Catalog / Retrieval Index
HA product profiles + current access, holds and deletion controls; exact storage quorum and node placement are pending
Failure policy: maintain valid business authority
Quorum or safe PostgreSQL authority lost -> financial writes stop
CH replica lost with insert quorum2 -> projection publication pauses
AI outage / Disaster recovery
AI unavailable -> deterministic closing can continue if its own gates pass
Independent backups / Coherent restore / Old-writer fencing; RPO/RTO TBD
HA is not a backup, a site-loss guarantee, or proof of continuous writes; IdP, keys, audit and catalog dependencies must also satisfy the selected profile.
